title: CoToGrasp: Contact-Topology-Conditioned Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via Canonical Workspace Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.19776v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current dexterous grasp planners primarily optimize for physical stability, focusing on whether an object can be grasped rather than how it should be grasped to support downstream functional tasks. However, conditioning grasp synthesis on specific human grasp taxonomies typically requires prohibitively expensive, object-annotated datasets. To address these limitations, we propose CoToGrasp, a novel generative framework that synthesizes diverse, stable grasps strictly conditioned on specific contact topologies. To bypass the data collection bottleneck, CoToGrasp is trained entirely in an object-agnostic manner. We introduce a feature-based canonical workspace that projects local object features into a unified gripper-centric domain, effectively decoupling the semantic functional intent from the arbitrary object geometry. translated_title: CoToGrasp：通过规范工作区学习实现基于接触拓扑条件的灵巧抓取合成
translated_abstract: 当前的灵巧抓取规划器主要优化物理稳定性，侧重于物体能否被抓取，而非如何抓取以支持下游功能任务。然而，将抓取合成条件限制在特定人类抓取分类法上，通常需要成本高昂且带有物体标注的数据集。为解决这些限制，我们提出了CoToGrasp，一种新颖的生成框架，能够严格根据特定接触拓扑条件合成多样且稳定的抓取。为绕过数据收集瓶颈，CoToGrasp完全以物体无关的方式训练。我们引入了一个基于特征的规范工作区，将局部物体特征投影到统一的抓取器中心域，有效解耦了语义功能意图与任意物体几何形状。通过在该工作区内学习抓取器的固有接触流形，我们的模型实现了零样本泛化。
tldr: 提出一种基于规范工作区的生成框架，实现物体无关的零样本灵巧抓取合成，严格按接触拓扑条件生成多样稳定抓取。
en_tdlr: Propose a generative framework based on a canonical workspace that enables object-agnostic zero-shot dexterous grasp synthesis, strictly conditioned on contact topologies.
